Subject: CedarPoint pilot — handoff notes and immediate asks

Hi Karthik,

We closed CedarPoint this morning (deal D-18924-CP). Quick brief so CS can pick up:

- Scope: pilot (6 weeks) to validate Redwood API for triage-routing and embeddings for search.
- Commitment: dedicated small pool (2x A10G equivalent) with burst to Dedicated for go/no-go.
- Key dates: kickoff target 2026-09-07, acceptance window ends 2026-10-19.
- Attachments: SOW v1 and MAP in Drive (links below).

Main risks:
- Data residency: CedarPoint requires logs and KV cache not leave us-east-1.
- API keys: will want short-lived keys for staging; procurement expects a 3rd-party security questionnaire answered before keys.
- Volume: expected 150k tokens/day at pilot peak — may require batching config changes.

Asks for CS team before kickoff:
1) Owner: please nominate primary steward and backup.
2) Technical intake: confirm we can meet region-only routing and draft runbook for prefix caching behavior.
3) Acceptance criteria: help finalize the test set (we received an initial prompt set from Alex).

I recommend Tessa own the steward role given her experience with healthcare pilots, but leaving to you.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15m sync if helpful.

— Monica

Date: 2026-08-30T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint pilot — handoff notes and immediate asks

Tessa / Marcus — a few technical clarifications from infra/security:

- Region-only logs: we can configure the control plane to keep audit logs in us-east-1 for this customer and mark the tenant as region-restricted. Need SOC2 evidence sheet to attach — I'll circulate by EOD.
- KV cache: by default the runtime places short-lived KV shards on the serving host; I can add a config to pin KV to us-east-1 hosts only for this tenant. There is a small perf trade-off (2–4% latency increase) but acceptable for pilot.
- Batching recommendation: batching=64 looks fine, but recommend dynamic batching with a lower latency SLO (5th percentile) set at 120ms to avoid tail latency spikes.

I'll prepare a short runbook (attachment stub: cedarpoint_runbook.md) outlining the routing policy, KV pinning steps, and rollback play. Will share before the kickoff.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
